summary: Challenge Roadmap rev 2.2 (OWNER-CHALLENGE-ROADMAP-03). The owner found that the pipeline had dropped Challenge Admission section 3's construction ladder, so the ladder becomes the spine of construction iteration. Every Challenge enters Test/iterate at Level 0 and climbs one level at a time by the climb procedure: an expansion record, Carbon's reconstruction with tests, valid and matched adversarial runs under both profiles, ablation, interaction tests, clean-worker rebuilds, and opening to miners only after a person locks the level and validators serve its contract. A miner sends a declarative recipe and the contract digest it was written against, and the validator rebuilds with the reconstruction pinned in its own Carbon version, so a climb is a Carbon release. Levels not reached are NOT_RUN, frozen evidence and leaderboard entries name their level, and battery's Phase 1 includes its first climb, to Level 1. carbon/challenge_pipeline gains ladder.py, each record's construction block (battery at Level 0, OPEN, expansion 0001) and lessons.py: one entry after every execution, and a proposed revision adopted or declined by a named owner, never applied silently. The protocol is Challenge-neutral and improves through recorded revisions. Graphite, not Mira, is the testing agent. Rev 2.1's backend wording is corrected: JAX and PyTorch are where Carbon rebuilds a declarative recipe. No qualification, reward, deployment or LIVE authority.
